_comment: ADR-019 decision 1: numeric_environment_hash + accepted_image_digests + build manifest hash.
Text, therefore in git under ADR-014's rules. Concrete digests live here and never in an ADR.
READ THIS BEFORE TRUSTING numeric_environment_hash BELOW. It is null, and null is the honest
value: ADR-019 requires the predicate to be MEASURED from inside a running worker, and no
image has been built. Virtualization (Intel VT-x) is disabled in this machine's firmware, so
no container runtime can start here -- not Docker, not podman under WSL2. Writing a plausible
hash into this file would be exactly the failure the record warns about: 'a predicate we
cannot measure is a predicate we cannot enforce'. `container/build.sh` prints the measured
value at the end of a successful build; that is what goes here. Tracked as DEV-24.

note: The Dockerfile's FROM pins index_digest, which is the multi-arch index. The amd64 manifest
it resolves to is recorded alongside it so that a future reader can tell whether a changed
index digest actually changed the amd64 image or only added a platform.
This carries a `sha256:` prefix and that is correct: it is an OCI reference, not a field in
a FarSight hashed document. ADR-001 decision 7's bare-hex rule governs our documents; an
OCI digest keeps the spelling its own ecosystem uses.
ADR-019 asks for an exact `=version` pin per package. A snapshot timestamp reaches the same
determinism by a stronger route -- it fixes the entire archive the resolver sees, so
transitive dependencies are pinned too, which top-level `=version` pins do not achieve.
`resolved_versions` is null for the same reason as numeric_environment_hash: it is what apt
ACTUALLY resolved, which is a measurement and needs a build.

toolchain.note: The interpreter is uv's, not the base image's (ADR-019 decision 1, ADR-014).

measurement_status.reason: no container runtime on the build host: Intel VT-x is disabled in firmware, so WSL2 cannot start and neither Docker nor podman can run
measurement_status.blocked_on: enable virtualization in UEFI, then Virtual Machine Platform, then rebuild
what_is_not_claimed: that the image reproduces channel hashes bitwise
any Tier-A claim whatsoever -- the predicate is unmeasured, so no run can be Tier A
